description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeImageStyle operation
description_zh: 本文档介绍风格识别RecognizeImageStyle的语法及示例
name: RecognizeImageStyle

parameters.description_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
